notes: Combined Form N-14 (as filed January 8, 2021) for an open-end fund reorganisation: Managed Portfolio Series (open-end, Delaware statutory trust) acquires all assets of the Delaware U.S. Growth Fund (a series of Delaware Group Adviser Funds) in exchange for Jackson Square Large-Cap Growth Fund shares, followed by liquidation of the target. Fund_type is open_end_fund because the filer is open-end; kind stays merger per the kind guide. Exchange is stated as shares equal in aggregate NAV to the target holdings, so nav_for_nav. security_class is other because the shares are open-end fund shares, not common stock; uncertain. n_targets is 1 from the singular 'Target Fund' in the filing, not a counted list; uncertain. meeting_date and record_date are stated as dates. expected_close is stated as on or around April 16, 2021; the letter brackets it as April [16]. The filing states no exchange ratio or per-share cash, and no collar. Only shareholder approval is stated as a condition; the filing says a legal tax opinion is expected but does not present it as a condition, so tax_opinion is not recorded.
